title: Family Exam Stretch
welcome_lead: Debate the family. Is diversity a sign of decline or freedom? Build top-band evaluation here.
meta_desc: GCSE Sociology exam stretch evaluating family diversity from New Right, feminist and postmodern views.

walkthroughs.body_html: Charles Murray argues lone-parent families create an underclass dependent on welfare. The cure, he claims, is restoring marriage. Critics call this victim-blaming and ignore unequal pay.
Liberal feminists like Oakley showed women still do most housework. Duncombe and Marsden's triple shift shows women also do emotion work, supporting family well-being on top of jobs and chores.
Postmodernists like Stacey see diverse families as proof of choice. There is no single 'best' family; people pick partners, lifestyles and parenting models that fit them.
